#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```python
from fern import FernApi
from fern.environment import FernApiEnvironment

client = FernApi(
    token="<token>",
    environment=FernApiEnvironment.DEFAULT,
)

client.auth.register_a_user(
    name="name",
    email="email",
    last_name="lastName",
    location="location",
    password="password",
)

```
